name: SubWF 04D - Human in the Loop Agent Bridge

nodes.name: Auto-Assign Agent

parameters.query: =SELECT id, name, email, role, team FROM agents WHERE status = 'available' ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assigned_agent_id = agents.id AND t.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')) ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1;

nodes.notes: Assigns ticket to next available agent by workload.

parameters.query:
=WITH found AS (
  SELECT t.id AS ticket_id, t.ticket_number, t.status AS ticket_status, t.conversation_id, t.customer_id,
         c.full_name, c.phone_number, c.telegram_id, c.whatsapp_id, c.email,
         COALESCE(conv.channel, 'webchat') AS channel, COALESCE(conv.language, 'ar') AS language,
         COALESCE(t.assigned_agent_id, 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid) AS assigned_agent_id,
         COALESCE(t.category_id, 11) AS category_id
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN conversations conv ON t.conversation_id = conv.id
  WHERE t.ticket_number = '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.ticket_number || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.ticket_number || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
fallback AS (
  SELECT 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AS ticket_id,
         '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.ticket_number || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.ticket_number || 'TICK-1001').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS ticket_number,
         'open' AS ticket_status,
         'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AS conversation_id,
         'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AS customer_id,
         'DEPI Citizen' AS full_name,
         '+201000000000' AS phone_number,
         'citizen_user' AS telegram_id,
         '201000000000' AS whatsapp_id,
         'citizen@digilians.gov.eg' AS email,
         'webchat' AS channel,
         'ar' AS language,
         'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AS assigned_agent_id,
         11 AS category_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found)
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM found UNION ALL SELECT * FROM fallback) res LIMIT 1;

=UPDATE tickets
SET status = CASE WHEN '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.action || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.action) }}' = 'resolve' THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'in_progress' END,
    assigned_agent = '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_name || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_name || 'Support Agent').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    assigned_agent_id = COALESCE('{{ ($('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.body?.id || $('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') }}'::uuid, assigned_agent_id),
    resolution_notes = '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_message || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_response || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_message || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_response || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE ticket_number = '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.ticket_number }}';

nodes.name: Track First Response Time

parameters.query: =UPDATE tickets SET first_response_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ticket_number = '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.ticket_number }}' AND first_response_at IS NULL RETURNING ticket_number, first_response_at;

nodes.notes: Records first agent response timestamp. Idempotent.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, customer_id, sender_type, content, intent, provider)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.conversation_id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.customer_id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }}'::uuid,
  'agent',
  '{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_message || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'agent_direct_response',
  -- WhatsApp tickets are delivered by SubWF 06; the bridge claims this row via lifecycle_message_id.
  NULLIF('{{ ($('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.channel === 'whatsapp' && $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.ticket_id !== 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') ? 'whatsapp' : '' }}', '')
)
RETURNING id;

=INSERT INTO audit_logs (workflow_name, event_type, channel, payload)
VALUES (
  '04D_agent_response_bridge',
  'agent_replied',
  '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.channel || 'webchat' }}',
  json_build_object(
    'ticket_number', '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.ticket_number }}',
    'agent', '{{ $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_name || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_name }}',
    'action', '{{ $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.action || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.action }}',
    'assigned_agent_id', '{{ ($('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.body?.id || $('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.id) }}'
  )
);

nodes.name: Log Performance Metrics

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO agent_performance (agent_id, ticket_number, event_type, notes)
SELECT
  '{{ ($('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.body?.id || $('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $('Lookup Ticket & Customer').first().json.ticket_number }}'::varchar,
  'agent_replied',
  json_build_object(
    'action', '{{ $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.action || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.action }}',
    'agent_message_length', length('{{ ($('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.body?.agent_message || $('Agent Response Webhook').first().json.agent_message || '') }}')
  )::text
WHERE '{{ ($('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.body?.id || $('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.id) }}' IS NOT NULL
  AND '{{ ($('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.body?.id || $('Auto-Assign Agent').first().json.id) }}' != 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

nodes.notes: Logs agent response event with metadata to agent_performance table.
